It is a tall, industrial white cabinet mounted on caster wheels. The top angled face features a digital control panel/HMI screen with analog gauges, push buttons, and a small signal tower light on top. The front has latched access doors, a protruding collection tray, and a transparent viewing window near the bottom. Guide rollers for wire/cable feed are visible on the left side of the machine. A reliable series for Powder Applicator introduced for Wire & Cable Industry, Puretronics introduces LSP Series. Static Powder Applicator, also known as a cable powder applicator or cable dusting machine, is a specialized device used to apply talcum powder to cables. Talcum powder is a soft, inert mineral that acts as a lubricant and insulator, protecting cables from friction, wear, and corrosion. Static Powder Applicators are commonly used in the manufacturing and maintenance of electrical cables, particularly for high-voltage and fiber optic cables. --- ### Purpose of Static Powder Applicators for Cables - **Lubrication:** Talcum powder reduces friction between the cable conductors and the cable jacket or insulation, minimizing wear and tear during cable handling and installation. - **Insulation:** Talcum powder provides additional insulation between the cable conductors, preventing electrical short circuits and enhancing the cable's dielectric strength. - **Moisture Protection:** Talcum powder absorbs moisture, helping to protect cables from corrosion caused by humidity and water exposure. --- ### Advantages of Static Powder Applicators for Cables - **Excess Powder Avoidance:** The machine avoid excess powder application on the cable, thus maintaining the diameter of outer surface and avoidance of lump on the cable. - **Clean Shopfloor:** This machine doesn't allow the powder to spread on the shopfloor because of its design, does maintaining a clean environment. - **Coating Consistency:** The machine helps the cable to be used for further processes smoothly, since the powder is applied on consistently. The user gets enhanced experience during processes like stripping where if there is excess powder it may result in causing dirt on shopfloor and when there is less powder it might cause insulation tear-out. - **Low Air Consumption:** The machine uses less air consumption, thus saving on the cost of production. --- ### Technical Details
